tools.name: get_customer_policy

Returns available with observedAt and terms, or unavailable. Lead time is in minutes; interpret dates in the returned time zone

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "samuelz-chauffeur" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_ride · Private data: quote_ride, prepare_offer, get_offer_status · Public sink: quote_ride, prepare_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_ride · Private data: quote_ride, prepare_offer, get_offer_status · Public sink: quote_ride, prepare_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
